{{Quote|I want that spy!|Darth Vader|<ref name="ST2" />}}
This '''Rebel spy''' was a passenger on board a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency [[StarSpeeder 1000]] [[1 BBY/Legends|one year before]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Prior to the passengers and the spy boarding the ship in a [[Spaceport THX1138|space station]], the intended pilot [[AC-38/Legends|AC-38]] was absent as [[protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] accidentally replaced him via getting trapped by the autopilot during a last minute maintenance in the cockpit of the ship. After boarding the ship, but before it could depart the spaceport, [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] agents discovered the spy's presence and [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138|attempted to arrest]] the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]]. The vessel took off and fought its way past Imperial ships surrounding the space station. After being chased through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], the StarSpeeder landed and delivered the spy to safety.<ref name="ST2" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:RebelSpy-Tshirt.jpg|thumb|left|250px|An "I Am the Rebel Spy" T-shirt]]
During the ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' theme-park ride, the Rebel spy is almost always one of the ride's passengers, chosen at random and shown on a video screen in the cabin. The passenger can be either male or female, which changes the dialogue of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] representative who speaks to the passengers ([[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] or [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]). Occasionally, the spy will not be someone in the cabin, and an image of a generic person or an alien appears instead. The spy's final destination is also randomly chosen, with the StarSpeeder reaching the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel fleet]], a [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] starship hangar, or a [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] landing platform.<ref name="ST2" /> Merchandise sold at the parks included T-shirts and pins showing the [[Unidentified Prowler 1000 seeker droid|Prowler droid]] from the ride and the phrase "I Am The Rebel Spy."<ref name="FB t-shirt">{{Facebook|username=StarTours|url=StarTours/photos/a.168717493183898/585063748215935|name=Star Tours (Orlando, FL)|date=November 20, 2013|archivedate=20220317163654}}</ref>

Exactly how the spy ended up discovered depended on the specific opening used for the ride. The spy will either have his ride be stopped by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] himself alongside a Stormtrooper contingent and a TIE fighter squadron (with Vader also trying to reel in the escaping vessel with [[the Force]], only to find himself forced to release the escaping vessel trying to deflect [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shots from the ship's cannons) or otherwise be discovered by a Prowler droid scanning the vessel.<ref name="ST2" />

Later variations of the ride were added featuring elements from the [[Sequel trilogy]] of films, starting with {{Film|VII}} in [[2015]]. Though initially the update retained the "Rebel spy" theme (conflicting with the Sequel trilogy timeline), additional updates added in [[2017]] for {{Film|VIII}} featured [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] in a scene similar to Darth Vader's. In those scenes, the spy is working for the [[Resistance]] instead of the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="ST2" />
